records.text: Candace Owens said an article reported that Kash Patel was blocking Tulsi Gabbard's office
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I mean, once I saw the article—he was blocking Tulsi's office— I lost all faith in Kash.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms that an article described FBI pushback after National Counterterrorism Center director Joe Kent, under the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, accessed FBI files in the Charlie Kirk case. It also reports broader FBI-ODNI tension and a White House meeting involving Patel and Gabbard. The reporting does not establish that Patel broadly blocked Gabbard's entire office; Patel and Gabbard publicly described cooperation. Thus an article reported a real interagency dispute, but Owens's shorthand overstates its scope.

records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I handed over that information to Tulsi Gabbard's office. ... I also passed it off to Trump's office, Donald Trump's office.
I handed over that information to Tulsi Gabbard's office. ... I also passed it off to Trump's office, Donald Trump's office.

verification.notes: The contact report is Owens's first-person account. Searches and the opened public exchange did not yield the emails, delivery records or a recipient's confirmation. Her later acknowledgment of replies means alleged lack of follow-up must not be rewritten as literally no response. Reporting a threat would not itself substantiate it.

records.text: Owens said Tulsi Gabbard's office was the only government office that had responded to her warning about an alleged threat involving French intelligence agencies and Israel, and she thought the office had taken it seriously.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I have definitively run that to the only office that has responded and I think taken my threat was wanted to respond that I should say should thought that I've been saying about the French intelligence agencies working with Israel. ... And that is Tulsi Gabbard's office. I am doing everything that I can, but I am telling you that this is very scary.

verification.notes: This is a claim about private communications and Owens interpretation of an office response. Searches found no statement, correspondence, or acknowledgment from Gabbard office confirming either a response or an assessment of the alleged threat. The text was narrowed to Owens report and appeared-to-take-seriously qualifier.

records.text: Owens said she had been told a foreign legion was trying to kill her and had handed that information to Tulsi Gabbard's office.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yes, that's why I reported it to the correct officials in government. That's what I was told, and I handed over that information to Tulsi Gabbard's office.

verification.notes: The debate transcript and source replay confirm Owens publicly said she had been told of a Foreign Legion threat and handed the information to Tulsi Gabbard's office. Searches of current official and news sources found no independent confirmation from Gabbard's former office or another government record that the handoff occurred. The self-reported transmission remains attempted/unverifiable.
